participation.context: Wrote the line on his tables and shut them.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote one line under the old wedding note. You did not write a scene.

title: Wrote two maids in the wood

participation.context: Wrote the counts and did not add a speech.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You set the sixteen and the fourteen into the margin as counts, and you left the words off the leaf.

title: Wrote the bar-counts in the margin

description: Under the note, and no scene

story.body: You named the sixteen bars and the two maids, and you did not start the scene.

title: Said the sixteen bars and the two maids
